site.why: Holdfast is the gym 8 town (data/markets.json counter 'holdfast', badge 8, at (3634, 113, 6462)): the last stores before Victory Road, so late-game by place as well as by input. The booth is a 3x3x3 room 9 blocks under the counter's heightmap ground, not on the street: a villager struck by lightning is discarded even though MobsBeGone refuses the witch it would become (EXP-055 'Lightning'), and lightning cannot reach a villager that cannot see the sky and is more than 3 blocks under any strike point. Underground also keeps the booth off every street, lot and NPC the town plan seats, which this worktree cannot read (derived/towns is absent). The place function refuses to carve if any shell cell is air, water or lava (a cave, a cellar, an aquifer) and says so in a score

barterer.name: Garrison Barterer
barterer.why: level 5 (master) is the last level, so no trade can level it up and add vanilla trades; a profession other than none or nitwit, because those two have no trades table (EXP-055 'Profession')

why.priceMultiplier: 0 zeroes both the demand surcharge and the reputation (gossip) discount, which are each multiplied by it (EXP-055 'Price'); it does NOT touch Hero of the Village
why.maxUses: high enough that the shared stock never runs out between restocks (stock is per villager, so a small stock would let one player empty it for everyone); any restock only resets uses
why.xp: 0 so trading never raises the villager's experience
why.rewardExp: false: no experience orbs for the player
why.uses_specialPrice_demand: written as 0 so no default is relied on

rules.buy_count_one: every barter line's `buy` (cost A) has count 1 and its bulk cost goes in `buyB`. Hero of the Village takes max(1, floor((0.3 + 0.0625 * amplifier) * count)) off cost A whatever priceMultiplier is, but cost A is clamped to at least 1 and cost B is never discounted (EXP-055 'Price'), so a count-1 cost A cannot move
rules.distinct_inputs: `buy` and `buyB` are different items: the trade screen's auto-fill moves every matching stack into the first slot up to a full stack, so a line paying the same item in both slots leaves the second slot empty for a player holding fewer than a stack plus the second cost
rules.experiment_offers_never_gain: every experiment offer's output is one of its own inputs, at a count no larger than the worst-case (fully discounted) count paid of it, so it can stand in any world, the live one included

experiment_offers.purpose: the fixed line under test: a modded item on both sides, two inputs, the fixed-trade fields. Cost A is 4 so drift either way is visible; the player always loses 4 Poke Balls (or 1 if fully discounted), never gains

the control: the same villager, priceMultiplier 0.2 instead of 0. If its cost falls below 4 after trades while exp_two_inputs stays at 4, multiplier 0 is what holds the fixed line; if neither moves, a NoAI villager collects no trade gossip either. Worst case 1 Poke Ball for 1: never a gain
